title: CrackUDA: Incremental Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Improved Crack Segmentation in Civil Structures
mechanism: Incremental adversarial UDA with a shared domain-invariant encoder and domain-specific decoder parameters.
evidence: +0.65 mIoU source, +2.7 mIoU target over other UDA methods on CrackSeg9K subsets and BuildCrack.
adaptation: Per-source decoder parameters for the 5 label conventions plus a half-cell pool domain; drop the adversarial part on 478 cells if unstable.
min_experiment: Per-source decoder heads vs house; metric per-source test crack IoU. Kill: < +0.01.
prior_overlap: None (source-conditional prediction never tried; D17 overlap).
